When you cast that creature or when it enters, Torens triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate Evereth by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.

Resolve the Evereth ability.

2866-4708-4986-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

965-4949.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other blue creatures that do not have summoning sickness.

2178-2921-5931-5970.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
2178-2921-5931-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Awakening Hall.
Awakening Hall triggers, returning all creature cards in your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing one of the returned creatures.
When the creature dies, Marina triggers, and Funeral Room triggers if it's unlocked.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, if applicable, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Awakening Hall.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 once.
Repeat from step 1.
2178-2921-5931-5970.notes: If you start the combo with Funeral Room locked, you can still unlock it with Marina if you have three or more creature cards in your graveyard. During the first loop, you'll want to repeat steps 3 through 8 one additional time, instead choosing to unlock Funeral Room. Additional Marina triggers can allow you to lock and/or unlock other Rooms as desired.

670-1619-5887-6144.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-5887-6144.description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Goliath Paladin until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing Goliath Paladin to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Goliath Paladin until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Repeat from step 5.

Put the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.

Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Stunt Double.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Stunt Double into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Stunt Double to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.

168-2210-4768-4948.description:
Cast Mirrormade by paying {2}{U}.
Mirrormade enters the battlefield as a copy of Oblivion Ring, triggering Altar of the Brood and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Mirrormade's trigger, exiling Oblivion Ring.
Cast Estrid's Invocation by paying {2}{U}.
Estrid's Invocation enters the battlefield as a copy of the Oblivion Ring copy, triggering Altar of the Brood and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Estrid's Invocation's trigger, exiling Mirrormade.
Mirrormade leaves the battlefield, triggering itself, returning Oblivion Ring from exile to the battlefield.
Altar of the Brood and Oblivion Ring trigger.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling Estrid's Invocation.
Estrid's Invocation leaves the battlefield, returning Mirrormade from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 until each opponent has an empty library, then end the loop by choosing to copy or exile any other permanent.
